articles.headline: NFL Week 10: Big takeaways, questions and fantasy spin from Sunday's games
articles.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 10.

articles.headline: Seahawks beat Raiders 21-13 as Drew Lock throws for 2 TDs and Seattle sacks Fernando Mendoza 6 times
articles.description: — Drew Lock passed for 240 yards and two touchdowns, including a game-breaking 71-yard scoring toss to Jaxon Smith-Njigba, and the Seattle Seahawks beat Las Vegas 21-13 on Sunday to spoil the debut start of Raiders rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza.

images.name: Seahawks' Tory Horton bats kick-off while in end zone to avoid 2-minute warning
images.caption: Seahawks' Tory Horton bats kick-off while in end zone to avoid 2-minute warning

articles.headline: Rams win their 4th straight game, overcoming a slow start to crush the Cardinals 34-6
articles.description: — Matthew Stafford threw for 249 yards and three touchdowns, Blake Corum gained 100 yards on the ground and the Los Angeles Rams overcame a slow start to earn their fourth straight win by beating the Arizona Cardinals 34-6 on Sunday.

articles.headline: Citing short week, Colts sticking with Daniel Jones at QB despite dreadful start
articles.description: Colts coach Shane Steichen said the team will stick with Daniel Jones as starter despite a two-interception start that earned him a 2026-worst 1.7 QBR.

articles.headline: Week 10 winners and losers: Mahomes has biggest game in years; Taylor struggles
articles.description: Jahmyr Gibbs, Patrick Mahomes and Emmett Johnson put fantasy teams on their back in Week 10, while Jonathan Taylor and the Packers and Panthers' passing games had quiet days.
